notes.title: CHOOSE A KILLER BY YOURSELF (1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Key Changes:

Added the ability to CHOOSE the culprit yourself

You won’t lose an attempt if a character says: “I’m not in the mood to talk, come back later”

New achievements

New ending

The game no longer ends automatically — you can continue the investigation even after finding the final clue

Minor bug fixes and visual tweaks

notes.title: GAME LOGIC IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
Improved targeting logic for objects
Updated localization for the deduction map

notes.title: Hey, Detective
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45346723/232c2ae5ca217a1482e77f928bc7feeaf02b8f26.png[/img]

Detectives, we need your help!

And no, this isn’t about a crime this time.

As you know, after the first day of release, when our servers couldn’t handle the load, we received a huge number of negative reviews, which are now heavily affecting the working version of the game.

We’re not asking you to write a positive review. We’re simply asking you to share your honest opinion about the game and let us know what features you’d like to add, remove, or change.

By doing this, you’ll provide incredible support, for which we are already deeply grateful.

Thank you!

notes.title: MASSIVE BUGFIXES AND SERVER UPGRADE
notes.notes:
We are sincerely grateful to everyone who played DOOMED Detective Game and reported issues and bugs, most of which we have fixed in this update. We did not expect such a huge influx of players, which caused our server to crash and respond with the now-iconic phrase, "I'm not in the mood to talk right now, come back later." This has practically become a local meme.

Now, we have strengthened our servers, and they can handle significantly more players than before. In addition, we have fixed several issues with achievements, cursor disappearing, and more.

We will continue to improve the game and hope that even those who were disappointed due to technical problems will be able to dive in and truly enjoy the unique gameplay focused on humor and logical thinking.

Thank you, and "I'm in the mood now, come right in!"
